[EN] It appears that many of the spies disguised themselves as sailors to make it easy to go in and out of the village unnoticed. These suspicious sailors skulk around the pier.Put the report away.
[ES] Parece que muchos espías se disfrazaron de marineros para facilitar la entrada y salida de la aldea sin ser notados. Estos marineros sospechosos se recuestan por el muelle.Put the report away.
